case.title: Which pool check swallowed cancellation and dropped the healthy connection?
case.title_zh: 是哪次连接池检查吞掉取消并丢弃了健康连接？

findings.observation: One run of the original async pool check/cancel example at exact development source e1fc504e34d13e577730afb19b31388e58f42669 confirms cancellation is swallowed: the check Task returns normally, cancelled() is false, cancelling() is 1, and connections_lost becomes 1. The actual dropped Connection is open, absent from the pool, and still answers SELECT 1 after pool close. CPython3.12.16/private PostgreSQL17.1/pure-Python libpq; exit0, explicit connection/server cleanup, full preparation/run70.30s.
findings.interpretation: The independently held check Task object 0x71894b567040 matches CoroPerf runtime generation g6. Native get_stack contains only check. CoroPerf joins creation11 to the CancelledError observation104 inside pool_async.check and recovers launch_pool_check, missing from both the native pending stack and the cancellation observation. The same Task later exits by return. Extra API observation12 identifies Pool 0x71894b9e8110 and checked Connection 0x71894c0c7c20. Sixty focused observations are attributed; cleanup Tasks reusing the address as generations g7/g8 are excluded. The report already describes the cause; added evidence identifies the actual operation and historical submission context.
findings.limits: Read-only diagnostic references retain checked Connections and defer GC: this proves the pool drops an open healthy connection, not durable leakage without the observer. Original min_size3, slow-check sleep0.2s, cancellation at0.1s and existing create_task topology are retained; launch_pool_check only names the existing submission expression. Generic Task ancestry does not infer resource ownership or the cancellation initiator; Pool/Connection identity comes from extra API observations. Exact development source is tested, not cached distribution version metadata. Two exception propagation observations do not prove two exception objects. One successful async component; no replay, sync pool, escaping BaseException, wait_for deadline, starvation, version matrix or fix test.

case.symptom_zh: 准确开发源码 e1fc504e34d13e577730afb19b31388e58f42669 的原始异步 pool.check/取消示例一次确认：取消被吞，检查 Task 正常返回，cancelled()为false、cancelling()为1，connections_lost增加为1。实际被丢弃的连接仍打开且不在池中，池关闭后仍能执行SELECT 1。CPython3.12.16、私有PostgreSQL17.1、纯Python libpq；退出0，显式关闭观察到的连接和数据库。含准备运行70.30秒。
case.reasoning_zh: 独立持有的检查 Task 对象0x71894b567040与CoroPerf运行时代次g6一致。原生get_stack仅有check。CoroPerf把创建11接到pool_async.check内的CancelledError观察104，恢复原生等待栈和取消现场都缺失的launch_pool_check；同一Task随后正常返回。额外API观察12记录实际Pool 0x71894b9e8110与正在检查的Connection 0x71894c0c7c20。聚焦60个观察均归因，复用相同地址的清理Task代次g7/g8被排除。报告已描述原因，新增证据是实际操作及其历史提交上下文。
case.limits_zh: 只读诊断引用保留被检查的Connection并延迟GC；因此证明池丢弃了打开的健康连接，不断言无观察器时的长期泄漏。保持原始min_size3、慢检查0.2秒、0.1秒取消和既有create_task结构；launch_pool_check只给原提交表达式命名。通用Task祖先关系不推断资源所有权或取消发起者，Pool/Connection身份来自额外API观察。测试准确开发源码，不能拿缓存分发包版本元数据当源码版本。两处异常传播观察不代表两个异常对象。成功异步组件仅一次，无重放、同步池、逃逸BaseException、wait_for时限、耗尽、版本矩阵或修复测试。

limits: Observer retains strong connection references, deferring GC. The result proves the pool drops an open healthy connection; durable leakage without that observer is not established.
Original min_size3, .2s slow-check wrapper, .1s cancellation and existing create_task topology retained. launch_pool_check only names the original submission expression.

Generic Task capture recovers submission context; explicit API observations provide Pool and Connection identities. Task ancestry alone does not infer resource ownership or the cancellation initiator.
Exception observations at slow and check are propagation observations; no distinct exception-object count is asserted.
Exact development source e1fc504e with CPython3.12.16, private PostgreSQL17.1 and pure-Python libpq. Cached distribution version metadata is not the source version.
The issue already states the cancellation handling cause. Added diagnostic evidence is actual Task identity, missing historical submission context and explicit connection association.
One successful original async component; no sync pool, escaping BaseException, wait_for bound, pool starvation, alternate version or fix experiment.

native_observation.scope: Original min_size=3, sleep .2, cancel at .1 topology. Read-only connection references defer GC, so durable unobserved leakage is not claimed.
